title: Spreadsheets for YouTrack settings
description: Who can view and edit the spreadsheets in issues of this project.

readersCanEdit.title: Everyone who can see the issue can edit
readersCanEdit.description: Off (default): users with the Update Issue permission in this project can create and edit spreadsheets, from whichever role grants it (global, project or custom roles); users who can only read the issue can view them. On: every user who can see the issue can edit.

editorGroups.title: Groups that can edit spreadsheets
editorGroups.description: Members can create and edit spreadsheets in the issues they can see, even without the Update Issue permission.

viewerGroups.title: Groups that can only view spreadsheets
viewerGroups.description: Members can view spreadsheets but never create or edit them, even when they can update the issue. This overrides the two settings above.
